title: fumaria media var. vagans
intro: Fumaria media var. vagans, commonly known as small corydalis or lesser fumitory, is a plant species within the fumitory family (Fumariaceae). It has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Fumaria media var. vagans are attributed to its ability to act as a vasodilator, antispasmodic, and analgesic, making it potentially useful for managing conditions such as anxiety, insomnia, and pain. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
